sections.h: CHAPTER VIII — THE RESURRECTION AND THE LIFE
p: Arcazaiel EREIN is Harmony perfected. Yet here, the Ego, which is of God, may not look upon God, for he has been on a long journey in far lands, and he cometh hither travel-stained and weary. He has suffered a long Initiation, and now must his scars be purged, and his Soul refreshed. For He Who is Perfect can be beheld, in His Glory, only by the eyes of perfection, for looketh the Soul otherwise than this, his fall would be as the fall of Lucifer. Fear not, O Soul, newly come through strife and darkness, for the Holy Breath of Him Who breathed Life into man’s nostrils in the beginning of Time, pervades the Air of Nirvana, the Seventh Heaven. Therefore, Man, inhaling by means of his Celestial Body, draws into his own Soul the Life, the Beauty, the Perfection of the Christ. As he dwells upon the Threshold, so vitality invades him, and Holiness, perfecting him. He has sacrificed all that was mortal, all that was material; and all that was disharmonious has been destroyed far back when he contacted the

Celestial Fluids. His body of dust has returned to dust, his astral body has returned to the Astral Planes, his Spirit-body has been dissolved in the Solution of Matter, and his Soul has returned to God Who gave it. “This corruptible shall be made Incorruptible ; this mortal shall put on Immortality.” This is the Resurrection and the Life. This is the Last Trump, when the State of the Soul is decided, when sin and evil have dominion over it and power no more, when there can be no more tears nor weeping, for all former things are passed away. As the Celestial Body grows and is strengthened, so the shroud, with which the Angels have guarded the naked Ego, falls away, and he that hath overcome inherits the Kingdom of God. 'To him is given the palm of consummation, the Crown of the Child of God. He weareth the White Robe of him who hath been purified, and his Aura is a rainbow about his head. This is the Resurrection and the Life. He who cometh so far shall not see Death, nay, not even in the flesh. It is written, “ Thou shalt not suffer Thy Holy One to see corruption.” Therefore he also who partaketh of the Nature of the Most Holy of God shall also be given control of all the elements of his Manifestations. Of this you have seen examples in the passing of Elijah and of others also who came in the Name of the Lord. “IT am the Resurrection and the Life. No man cometh unto the Father but through Me.” For, in Nirvana are gathered the Sons of God, and verily the Day shall come when all shall so be gathered,

a Host which no man can number, and maybe in that Day He will lead us forward into the Infinite toward a God whom we cannot reach, even in thought, for He hath no Form that we may behold Him, even ia our inmost being. Blessed and holy is he who cometh to this Resurrection; all the pain of his development and of his purification are but a dream that has passed in the Light of the Eternal Dawn. Blessed are the sorrows that Man endures since they are but the outward form of that reorganization of disharmony within his Spirit, which shall so be blended into the Eternal Harmony of ecstatic Vision. Amen. This is the Resurrection wherein Man leaveth his body of Matter and is incarnated into the Magnetic Essences. I speak of Matter as you know it, as conglomerations of atomic particles forming the illusion of solidity. ‘Thus into Matter was hurled the Soul of Man, thus from its dark morasses has he risen to fall again, and yet again. His free-born Ego has been encased in vaporous bodies and in the protoplasmic organisms of flesh. Long has he sought the release that is alone the reward of Harmony wherein he may attain mastery over the Elements. ‘Thus attaining, he cometh at last to the Resurrection. His bodies of Matter are shed as one casts worn clothing, and he finds himself as he is, and has always been potentially, a Son of God, created in the Image of Him Who is All in All. After a Pilgrimage through Mirage and Illusion, thus he findeth Reality, for here is the pure substance which 11S animateth all things, the Source of the generation of all Elements. Yet the Elemental Fluid is not without
Form, forsooth, for it manifesteth everywhere in
Sublime Form. In Itself It is Light, It is Movement, It is Vibration. Herein is a galaxy of Rainbow
Diadems, not for Man alone, but for every object of Nature. Every tree, every flower in that ecstatic

Garden of the Lord radiates an Aura of Holy Beauty, for having inhaled the Divine Breath, it giveth again that which it hath received, tinged moreover by the radiations of its individual powers. Herein, Man may contact a single blossom and gain from its essence something which erstwhile he lacked, and the blossom will give in conscious gladness, and be again replenished from the Fountain of Living Water, from the Breath of God.
O simple mysteries you know not of! Even on your gross, sodden earth you may gather some good from the Aura of a little flower. Why think you the Lord
God created these blossoms? For the good of Man, aye, verily, and not for the good of his eyesight only, _ but more than this. The flower shall not inherit the

_ consciousness of Man, but it is, and shall be, a partaker in Cosmic Consciousness however minute the degree of its capacity for receptivity. powers for initiative and action, Man the is endowed with flower is endowed with grace to give of its own essence, to be a channel for the divine Vitality, in which it is enabled however minute the degree to exhale it. For scientific details you may look with benefit to your own material knowledge, I give you here the key only, for I would

speak of those things which are beyond the bounds of the Material. In the pigments which cause the colourations of plants of all kinds there are special chemical solutions having a definite affinity with Man’s own organisms, and they must and do react upon him morally and physically, for the physical and moral are combined in this material nature to an extent not recognized as yet. Why did God clothe your fields in gentle green if it were not to give peace and restfulness to the striving, weary earth? All, all, you take for granted and give no thanks or even acknowledgment to Him Who giveth all. Thus, where blossoms the Lotus in Nirvana, the Heavenly Flowers gather, each according to its kind, just such Elements of the Divine Breath as they need for the processes of their own alchemy, and Man, newly come among the Blessed, may gather that which he needeth. Celestial Blossoms! Should I stay to describe them to you? They are far beyond the descriptive genius of the greatest among the manipulators of your poor earth-language, and such genius have not I. I concern myself with Science and fundament causes, together with those effects which Man has overlooked to his own loss and injury. Mayhap my lord Zabdiel may attempt the feat in part ere this book be closed. Nirvana is the Nucleus of all known Creation. It therefore has its Counterpart upon every plane and condition of existence. It is for this reason that I leave the Divine Heights to describe to you the parallels between the ecstatic consummations and their physical duplicates in the earth state. For by this, Man may learn much, not only that which shall benefit him now, but also in future conditions, for, if he is able to acquire vitality from the various manifestations of Cosmic Life, he is the better fitted for his journey through all spheres of existence, for he is equipped with the knowledge of how to sustain himself and to progress toward the Ultimate Felicity. Also, it is only by analogy that I may describe to you the conditions obtaining in Nirvana. We are in the Presence of the Light of the World. His very Breath is Light, and in that Light is Life, Life abounding infinitely, and Truth and Colour. Of colour I speak in this connexion, for it partaketh of the same qualities of emotion as those I have described in speaking to you of flowers. Again, experiment for yourself. Walk through a garden in the full flood of midsummer sunshine and mark the blaze of colour in the herbaceous beds. All the shades of the Spectrum will be there in all their varieties. Now wait until the sun goes down and in the twilight return to the same spot. What will you see there now? Dim shapes that you know are flowers, but where is the galaxy of their colouring? Only shades of grey are visible, fading from white to black. And so with the Blossoms of Nirvana. In the dim shades of your twilit earth the widest range of colour

you can obtain is that comprised within the Spectrum. In Nirvana, the Source of Light, the whole gamut of radiant tints bursts forth in a galaxy of ecstatic beauty. These are colours you know not of. They are beyond the radius of human vision. Again, it is a matter of vibration, for vibrations of Light produce colour, and only those of a given length register upon your optic lens. ‘This I have explained beforehand, but I repeat it here, because, common as is this elementary knowledge among you, the burden of it is lost sight of almost entirely, and you ignore the phases of Light that are seen clairvoyantly and that you know, by very common-sense deductions, must exist. From time to time your Spectrum is set for you in the sky that all may behold. You see it as an arc, because the remainder of its Cycle is hidden by your own earth. You do not doubt the completing arc exists, although you are unable to distinguish it through the grosser material of the earth formation. It appears to you also as a narrow belt of seven colours. There are colours within and without the width of this visible band. Why should you doubt their existence because their vibrations are not distinguishable to you? In the Summer Garden of the Lord there is Colour beyond the soaring images of fancy, colour that is drawn from the Holy Source of Light and transmuted with celestial pigment. All this, man may imbue into his own Body, and no words of mine may describe the ecstasy of his Soul. Each flower glows and trembles with beauteous hue and exhales a radiant aura, palpitating with Beauty. Each globule of water flashes a thousand rays comparable to the scintillations of a cut diamond, and this analogy is mean in the extreme, but the best that I can find among your gross materials. The Body of Man is radiant as crystal glass, glowing with colour which is in itself indicative of his virtue and accomplishment. Here, indeed, is the Light of Truth, but no Man come hither may fear its Rays for he himself is perfected else could he not have come. I speak of Light, I speak of Water. For He Whose Breath gave Life to Man, He Who is the Light of the World, is the Fountain also of Living Water, the Source of Refreshment and Renewal. Even your own water on earth flows from this Source of Energy. You do not realize this. How came water upon the earth-planet? Within, it was a glowing mass, hardening into shape and form. Water came from without, formed by the contact of heat with cool, celestial air by which steam was produced from those particles of moisture from the etheric Spheres. The warmth of the sunlight will condense the water upon the earth’s surface and convert it into clouds and vapour. Thus, a planet of lower vibrations, invisible to Man, contacting the earth’s aura, will be enabled to withdraw from it some elements of moisture necessary to organic life. This system has been in operation all through the gamut of the Spheres, and through all phases of creation. Therefore, the Christ, speaking through Jesus, in saying “TI will give of the Water of Life freely, 120

spoke not alone in parables, but uttered an abstruse and fundamental Truth which was not recognized by the world in the days of Jesus, and is not, in fact, recognized to-day. The Light-Waves are the only vibrations you recognize as endowed with a limitless power of progression through astral space. ‘Take them as an example of projected vibration, and, as they radiate from a common Centre, coming directly or indirectly from the universal source of Light, the Sun, be convinced that thus travel also those more subtle forms of magnetism, many of which are quite intangible to you now. Also, as universal Matter has a common centre in the solar body, so believe that Cosmic Matter is united in the common Life radiated by the Living Nucleus of all creation. Thus, you mark the progress of Light through the Spheres, but not the progress of water, since the water is vaporized by the warmth of Light-rays and becomes invisible to the human eye. ‘Thus, the Celestial Elements experience the same descent into Matter which is undergone by Man himself, but here I touch upon a subject so vast that I may not digress so far as to expound even the most elementary of its phases. Suffice it if I say that all Elements descend into Matter, and are utilized therein by Man, himself also a produce of Sublime Elements incorporated in flesh. ‘The whole life of man on earth is a counterpart of his Life in Heaven, only upon an infinitely lower scale. Your own earth stands to you now as the lowest known form of Matter, because the Soul of Man, being Divine in Essence, aspires. Lower forms exist, this we know to our sorrow, for the earth itself is dark enough, alas, to cause us grief, and here life and conditions correspond to those of earth, but lower still in the Scale of Being. This correspondence persists through all the intermediate Planes, and herein lies great consolation, for Man shall not, naturally, find himself in an environment which is altogether strange. Death will but implant him within an environment wherein he will find in tangible form those creations of his mind which had no analogy with earth, and, although the customs will, mayhap, not be such as he has known hitherto, yet will he find much that is familiar in all its outward forms. Life, Nature, the Elements, all are perfect at their Source, and manifest in perfection; all are vitiated by their descent into Matter and contorted by the mind of Man. All follow the same Cycle of progression in the Great Scheme of Evolution which is the Gateway to Nirvana. Thus, as the Divine Life-Force interpenetrates Man’s flesh, so the inner perfection of created Nature interpenetrates the particles of physical matter. Therefore, then, Man, dwelling inwardly in his refined person, may absorb from natural products that which is in affinity with himself. Bathing in clear water, he will absorb vitality which would remain untapped by the more material personality; unclothing his body to the light, he will receive through the medium 122

of its rays some virtue of the Transcendent Light which is the Origin of all Illumination. He shall walk among the flowers, and his emotions shall be stimulated and purified, he shall eat of the fruits and they shall nourish his body in such measure that it shall resist disease and the disabilities of age. He shall breath the pure air and inhale into his Soul the Life everlasting. He shall open his mind to the vast spaces of the Cosmic and receive Eternal Wisdom. Thus, Man has not a dual, but a multiple personality, and every phase or expression of his being interpenetrates his outward body exactly in the same manner as Matter is interpenetrated by the Magnetic properties of Life and Force. At every point of consciousness, Man has affinity with a corresponding condition of Matter. Hence clairvoyance, clairaudience, are not super-normal but natural, and their absence indicates not sanity, but a gross condition of material development. ‘This is universal on the earth plane, and once the Earth developed spiritual faculties it would stand in different relation to the other units of the Universe unless the state of progression were universal. It is expedient that Progress be a concerted movement, each plane affecting another to its betterment so that all may go forward in harmony. The significance of the transference of Thought, therefore, among the Astral Bodies, is important. The movement of the Planets affect the Celestial Light Rays just as the radiations of the Spectrum are broken up by a prism. Each unit within the Cosmos is influenced as it requires. You are not aware of these

THE NEW NUCTEMERON Colour-Rays ; you do but feel their effects upon yourselves, you suffer periods of depression and disturbance and others of Revival and Prosperity. Old structures must be broken down in order that new may be builded, cavil not therefore at periods of tumult, for they are the birth-pains of new development. It is well if evil may be corrected in the flesh without penetrating further into the rarer nature of Man within, where, by reason of its own substance, it must contact a higher frequency current of Celestial Power. Therefore, the Magus, entering the Courts of Nirvana while yet he animates his body of flesh, contacts upon the Threshold the Supernal Wisdom. Arcazaie: l aie

March 19th, 1929. Arcazaiel ET, say you, Man who has scaled the heights in Spirit returns to the flesh without conscious memory of his experience. Incarnation is not Life in itself, but a phase of existence, yet the part sustains the illusion that it is the whole, and the focus of being is thereby wrongly set. Man awakens to a little hour of solar day, and for him it is his Eternity. Would you it were otherwise? Say not ce “yes” without due thought, for Thought may sometimes carry Desire to the point of gratification, and what new sorrows must come upon the world were this desire gratified ! Why was the human brain created incapable of containing the magnitude of Cosmic Truth? Some there are who have been enabled so to overcome the exigencies of the flesh that they have brought to the surface of physical life the wisdom that is hidden normally in the deeps of the Soul’s consciousness. These were the Prophets, the Seers. ‘These incarnated that the world, through them, might have light.

These were Souls progressed beyond the borders of Temptation, and no past lay behind them unatoned. Through Fire, through Water, and in the Silence had their Spirits been tried, and thus came they, in the strength of the Most High to accomplish the Work of Angels. Shall Mankind liken themselves to these? Think awhile, and consider the Celestial Love manifested in this strange faculty of forgetfulness, of oblivion. I tell you solemnly, that, lacking this, yours were a crazy, mad, tormented world, writhing in a hopeless morass of impotence and regret. First, I repeat, your body of flesh is attuned to material conditions and there is harmony between Matter and the carnal brain. You take pleasure in physical enjoyments, in terrene artistry, in human affection, in mental dissipations. The sunlit river, the verdant spring and golden autumn, the sea, the mountain and the dale; all these delight you, and so it was ordained. Fatigue of body, limitations of sight, these are so much the expressions of habit as to pass undiscussed. Now, my point is this, think you this felicity would remain were the brain cells to conceive and bring forth the knowledge of the Supernal Spheres? The Soul has beheld the Living Waters, the Eternal Sun, it has walked in the Garden of the Lord, and sensed perfection within its own Body; could it longer tolerate impurity, darkness, miasmas, mists, fatigue, perversity, sin? Could the weak solar sunlight satisfy longer the eye that has been dazzled by the Light of 126

God? Could the petty recreations of earth please the Soul that has delighted in Nirvana? Could gross, stale, and impure food satisfy one who has tasted the fruits of Paradise? I tell you, no. And this is not all. The majority of men upon the earth to-day, go upward and not down. Their Spirits project themselves in sleep into the future Spheres, and they remember not. It is expedient they remember not. Yes. But how much more expedient is it that the Past also is expunged? I argue not with those who believe Life comes with birth, for they deny, ipso facto, integral Divinity. If the Soul is of God, then it has descended from God, it is incarnated into Matter, but not directly, for Matter, being gross, cannot contact the Divine. There must be an intervening vehicle of Astral and Spirit Matter. If the Soul has not descended through the Arc of Involution, then it is not of God. If the Soul of Man, incarnating, be not Divine, then it shall not acquire Divinity. Ifit isnot Divine, it is mass without Motion, a product of Inertia, since all Motion, all Life, are Divine in their Source and substance. Therefore, thou who believest in God, must needs believe in God within thyself. Man is not a god, but he partaketh of the Divine, since so he was created, and the created may not liken himself to the Creator although he be produced out of His Substance. In Nirvana, our bodies shall be as the Body of the Living Christ, verily they shall be truly in His own

Image, but we shall not be Christs. Our bodies shall be dependent for Life upon His Body, the Breath that sustains us upon His Respiration, the Light of our eyes upon His Light, our Refreshment upon His Gift of the Fountain of Waters. We shall see Him as He is, be ourselves as He is, but dependent upon Him our Creator, for severed from Him we should be nought at all. Man may say “I am divine,” but not “I am a Divinity,” he may say, “ I am one with Christ,” but not “I am a Christ,” he may say, “‘ I am Immortal,” but only so long as he acknowledge his Source of Immortality. There is but One God, and Man dwells in Him and Hein Man. The planets are of the sun and take their light from the sun, but, were the sun to be hidden, of themselves they could not shine. If Man were not Divine, he could not live, if he were himself a Divinity, he could not Sin. Man is both Divine and vulnerable, for he has insulated his divine Magnetism and breasted the disharmonies of Matter. The free-will, which once bound the Soul to God by the eternal link of attraction, also suffers insulation and its electrons are free to suffer counter-attraction. ‘These are responsible for those internal disharmonies which thrust the Ego deeper and deeper into the vortex of Matter. The majority of Mankind are arising from the Vortex. The earth plane is set upon the Ark of Evolution. It is not the lowest point to which the Spirit of Man may descend.

It is apparent, therefore, that the lower Man descends, the more base the Matter which he contacts ; the greater is the potentiality of his ultimate state. His sufferings increase. He is hurled back again and again to incarnate in surroundings with which his natural affinity is so strong that until he has overcome his unnatural attractions, he may not leave them. The Divine Life fights within him, and he rises to contact the Celestial Essences. Here, the evil within him is destroyed, the false accretions of his integral magnetism are torn from him by cleansing flames. As yet, he cannot breast the tide, he sinks again that he may regain that which he has lost. He re-incarnates, perhaps on a new plane, bringing into carnate life the desire for strength and purity. Heis given opportunity, perhaps in the form of endeavour, of striving, of endurance. A Soul on its way to Nirvana, it enters earth-life. Who shall judge it? It comes, the future unknown, the past expunged. It comes into a new world, a new page is turned, a clean page. Would you it should be tortured by the remembrance of shame and agony, the thought of heinous deed and unrequited debt? Should it be haunted by the remembrance of debased humanity, still wallowing in the caverns of darkness ? Not so is the Mercy of God shown towards His Creation. Each phase of existence is a new beginning, and the Ego incarnating is alike forgetful of the past and ignorant of the future. It stands at the portal of

Opportunity, imbued with the faculty of acquiring wisdom, presented with occasions for atonement, and with sorrow that shall exalt and purify. I do not say that, of necessity, the human Soul incarnates repeatedly into one phase of life. The natural course of the Soul is progression, and by the _ word “incarnating ” I do not necessarily intend to convey the assumption of a body of flesh such as you know it. Upon whatever plane the Ego may rest, it incarnates into the Matter of that plane, that is, it assumes chemical material from the nature of that sphere in order to render itself articulate and capable of functioning normally in its present surroundings. At death, so called, you consider that the Ego becomes discarnate, but in reality it incarnates into the astral, or into the spirit. Both these States imply the assumption of Matter. Refined Matter, certainly, but still substance which is integrally chemical. It is only with the attainment of Nirvana cometh the true Resurrection out of material conditions and the Revelation of the Body of naked Magnetism which is the real Substance of the Soul. Of a truth, re-incarnation into flesh is not so uncommon as some of you believe. It occurs when the necessity arises. You have many analogies in earthlife which correspond to such necessity. A child may return, term by term, to the same class if its lessons’ have been unlearned, or its mentality incapable of grasping the lesson. Of its free-will the spirit returns, and not alone for purposes such as this, but betimes for atonement, 130

and at times, also, because there are labours that may be accomplished. In no case is Memory re-born into a new state. Atonement is unconscious, and many there are who cavil at human woes who would be silenced were the tome of the past be opened and the blotted page revealed. ‘There are some who have uttered thanksgiving that they were not among that curious crowd on Calvary who reviled the Holy Christ in the hour of Supreme Sacrifice. I tell you that no memory of such an act could be endured. ‘This is Man’s Hell, but it is short-lived. He is permitted to atone. Out of the darkness, he may come back to the earth filled with the light of solar day. He cometh care-free, forgetful. ‘There, he may love the Christ of God, he may labour in His Name, he may suffer and be himself sacrificed for His Love. ‘Then, when he reaches those planes where memory unfolds, the poignancy of remorse is softened, the infamy belongeth already to yesterday, and the sorrow is expunged in the joy of Service and of Love. Nothing is forgotten. Every act, every thought of Man registers upon the ether, upon the Matter even, of his surroundings and is imprinted upon the substance of its affinity. There is no memory that the Mind of Man may escape, but the gamut of its incidents unfolds slowly as the leaves of a book. As he advances, and can bear the knowledge, so are the pages turned. Only when an act has been atoned shall permanent knowledge of it reach the evolving Ego. 131

Some there are who have incarnated and remained comparatively immune from evil perversions; these have fewer regrets and fewer sorrows. They have plumbed the density of Matter fortified by the strength which sustains them through conscious communion with the Source and substance of their Being. These indeed are the Happy Band of Pilgrims. Others have descended into the Abyss. They have arisen to fall again. ‘The Fires have scorched them, and the Waters have gone over their head. Through great endurance these Souls arise, and for them alone is the fuller knowledge of God’s Infinite Mercy, for them alone is the realization of divine Sympathy such as inspired the Act of Calvary. For them there is rejoicing and song and thanksgiving. “Shall there not be more rejoicing for the one sheep that was lost than for the ninety and nine within the Fold? ” For they that were humbled shall be exalted, those which have striven shall accomplish, those who were sorrowful shall rejoice exceedingly, for unto Him which overcometh shall be given the Crown of Life. Thus Man cometh to perfection. The gamut of his experience is unfolded in the vast kaleidoscope of Memory. His senses are perfected into consummated power, his eyes are opened to the vista of Creation, his ears to every tone of the Cosmos, his nostrils to the perfume of the Cosmic World which is the Incense before the Throne; his lips may taste the sweetness which cometh forth of the strength 132

of his striving and its accomplishment, and his touch heal and quicken in the Power of the Most High od. He has passed the Veil of the Inner Tabernacle, for him are unfolded all Mystery, all Wisdom. His Mind inhales Inspiration from the Divine Mind, he is linked with Him, mind and body, and in that Link is the Life Everlasting. Amen. This is the Justification of Being as we know it at present, this is the issue of endeavour. Only that which is Sublime survives, that which is beautiful, that which is ecstatic. All pain, all sorrow, all ignominy, all sin, are as a dream that has passed away. ‘The memory of such is quiescent, because it has begotten experience and Understanding ; thus it lives on its offspring, but glorified. O fainting hearts that recognize not in the sorrows of to-day the birth-pains of a Rapture that shall live with Eternity! Is the preparation too rigorous? Is the Way too rough to tread? Did not He tread it also, O son of man? He took our nature upon Him. You do not realize the magnitude of this implication. He completed the Cycle of human progression, with all the processes which it involved, without pollution, and yet, identifying His Holy Body with our sin, He contacted the profundities of Matter, and suffered Himself to be cleansed by the only means open to Mankind, that of Sacrifice and Atonement. He incarnated upon the earth planet into a body of flesh, He took upon Him the limitations of the flesh.
The physical brain of a man, however pure, could not express the Mind of God.

Great Knowledge, great Wisdom, great Power He was able to exteriorize into surface consciousness from the Divine Mind within, but only in such measure as to be an example to man. Unattained, but not unattainable, the Ideal which He set. ‘That the memory of His Divine State and Purpose was suppressed by the confines of the physical body, is apparent in His prayer in the Garden of Gethsemane. He had subjected His Godhead to Manhood, and could now only re-attain | His State by Sacrifice. His Body was the perfect
| instrument by which God might speak to Man, _ because it was attuned in perfect harmony to the Will of God.

If you believe, merely, that a carpenter’s son of Nazareth was inspired by divine illumination, then you have reduced the lofty Symbol of Sacrifice to mere terrene significance. You have docked yourselves of the ecstatic hope of beholding the Son of Man Glorified. You have lost the Love of God as a personal Factor. For you, it is cosmic, vague, because it hath no Form that Man may see, no Eyes that shall regard him with infinite tenderness, no Lips that shall utter Benediction. The light of the World has an unknown Source, The Fount of Living Water no Spring.
Yet, if you believe that the Christ, incarnate in Jesus, was God manifest in Power in Omniscience, could He have said “ Follow me”? Can how then incarnate man be as God? 134
Nay, verily He was as your text has

it, Very God and very man because of the subjection of the Godhead into Manhood that the Supreme Act of Sacrifice might be consummated and the Way of Life made plain. If it were otherwise, how think you the earth could have contained Him Whom the Cosmos cannot hold? Verily, in such case, the whole system of Universes would have been changed, and the Earth become the central Source of Light. Light cometh from God the Father. Verily, but it is only through the Holy Medium of the Christ that it reaches our Spheres, just as it is through the medium of the visible sun that light is distributed upon the Earth. Be reasonable, therefore, and content that you have beheld in flesh the Divine incarnated, and that from henceforth you may behold the Christ in Jesus. For, in earlier periods, Man had not this advantage. Only the Seer and the Holy Prophets who had been elevated in Spirit to Nirvana, were enabled to look upon any manifestation of the Divine, and Man, also, having passed from the physical state, had before him many Spheres of Progression ere he could reach the Supernal Vision. Thus, in incarnating, the Divine Christ took unto Himself a human Likeness. ‘This Appearance was the outer surface of the various strata of Being, just as it is in Man. It is apparent, therefore, that, in withdrawing from the flesh, the Imprint of His Physical Personality remained stamped upon the Astral and Spiritual Form, which He had assumed in order to reach a condition in which incarnation was possible.

God could not contact flesh, many strata of nature were necessary before the Current of Divine Force could be sufficiently insulated for such a purpose. It is written, that for three days He entered into the Hells, veiling His Holy Light that We might pass even into the dim Spheres of Evil. Therefore, since the hour of the Crucifixion, is a great sign and a Great Wonder known to Man. In all his states he may behold God manifested. That is, the Christ, once having assumed all States to which Man can be subject, is able to reassume such conditions at will. A man in the flesh, desperately desiring it, and in great virtue or need, may see Him as He walked in Galilee—Mankind, likewise, having passed the veil of death, may behold Him as He comes to them in the Intermediate Spheres. As the purity of Man’s own Spirit enables him, so he will see the Christ. Ever fuller becomes the Vision, ever Fairer. With every upward grade His Glory and Presence are more complete, whilst He loses nothing of Personality. Nay, I censure you not, pity you not, O evolving humanity, but, rather, I rejoice with you exceedingly, for I have been permitted to gaze into the Nirvana of Ecstasy that awaits the coming of Mankind. March 26th, 1929. Zabdiel ap Amen. EHOLD, the Neophyte is become the Magus, Amen. “My lot has fallen unto me in a fair ground, yea, I have a goodly heritage.” Come with me upon the back of the South Wind and upon the Zephyrs, inhale the rising perfumes of ozone and of flowers, come past all the confines of earth and her narrow limits, beyond the principality of the New Moon, beyond the Silver Path of the Milky Way, beyond the realms of astral diamonds set in the targe of purple space. Come beyond Time and Space into the Courts of Eternity, the Garden of the Lord. And here shall you behold the Sun which illumines all suns, you may bathe in the Waters which replenish all waters and in Fountains whose spray slakes the thirst of all Universes. You may inhale the Air which first breathed the Life-Spirit into Man. You may harken to the Music which is the Harmony that unites all creation and Melodies which are the Source of Cosmic Joy. Here, there arises from the Bowl of Incense the Perfume which is the Prayer of all ‘Time, all People; ee) it mingles with the scent of ten thousand times ten thousand blossoms, and returns in Benediction.
There are no colours like unto these colours which tint not alone the vegetation but every particle of
Atmosphere. O little Spectrum of seven shades !
Again ten thousand Spectrums have spread the glorious Auras since the confines of earth were left.
O radiant Glory of which earth has no conception!

O Blossoms nurtured in magnetic Soil, watered by the Streams of Life, unfolded in the Light of the Sun of everlasting Righteousness, stained with the vivid hues of sublimated emotion and of Supreme Sacrifice scented with the Breath of Creation! Can Man visualize such as These?
And here in the Garden walketh Man, whose life sprang from the Divine Nature which was God’s Own Image, in the Presence of Him Who, of His own Will, descended into the image of Man.
“ And the lion shall walk with the lamb, and a little child shall lead them.”
For here shall all creation be gathered together in the fullness of its inherent beauty, in the issue of its
Divinely wrought Inception. And the birds of the air shall sing to the Glory of God, and all that lives shall praise Him.

As yet we know not the Life that must be in that ecstatic Garden, we cannot even behold it in the fullness of its beauty, for our senses are veiled lest we venture beyond our powers of beholding and are flung backward into the Abyss of Matter. Yet this we know that when at last we may claim admittance as Citizens 140

of Heaven, then our Souls shall have no further seeking, for here is Nirvana, the Fulfilment of the Heart’s Desire. We know that no Joys shall pall, no Ecstasy be beyond our endurance, for here is the Source of all Life, all Being, all Animation, all Emotion. The heart of Man shall feed upon that which it desires, for all desires are purified, and Man shall be found in affinity with the Godhead from Whose Divine Source he sprang. He shall be one with Him, one in Love, in Power, in Wisdom, and yet himself still a conscious personality, just as the Christ descended will retain the Personality of Jesus. ‘This for a time, we know not if it be for ever, but we know of a certainty that Man, thus exalted has travail no more, neither will that be demanded of him which he shall not desire. We believe that Ecstasy shall not be expressed in idle Adoration. We know that from Hence must come all answer to prayer, all administration of worlds whose number is legion. From Hence flows all Light, all Waters, all Music, all Harmony, all Wisdom, all Power, all Love. We know this Holy Rule is not impersonal and automatic, we know the Divine Creator worketh through His Angels, and that His Word is passed from Sphere to Sphere until It reaches even unto the Outlands of His Kingdom. Therefore, our praise, our Love, our Worship, will still be manifest in labour, and our Ecstasy shall be in Service. If our God labours ever for the welfare of His Creation, if He hearkens to the prayers of the multitude, and suffereth not His little ones to perish, thus, should we who are His, desire an Eternity of idleness, lounging upon His footstool? Not yet, not yet. Not until that which is Perfect shall have replaced all imperfection, until the winds of His magnetic Love have winnowed away the chaff, and darkness is made visible in Eternal Light. This is the Capital City, the New Jerusalem. This is the Seat of Justice, the Centre of Administration. This is the Source of Life, the Nucleus of Cosmic creation, the delocalization of all Energy. I speak of that which I have beheld in vision, it is a Land of Motion. How shall I describe it? For within the magnetic Cores is the only Reality, and in its emanations are the only Forms which are not illusory. For here, the Soul of Man and the Soul of Matter are in affinity, and their Substance is one with the Divine. And here, there is no Temple of God, for His Palace is the Temple, and there are many Abiding-Places, for His Ministers and for His People, and He Himself shall rule over them. And they shall behold Him in His Glory upon the Throne, and in the Garden He shall walk among them. And they which have travailed most shall be nearest Him to serve, and those who most have loved Him. For all travail, all pain, all tears shall be as a dream that has tortured the night and fades with the mists of the Morning. Thus the heavens and the earth shall pass away, but the Nirvana of God shall remain. Thus the Neophyte, ascending, shall complete his Hours of Labour and win the Crown of his Reward. 142

We give this Epilogue. Our blessing be upon you, and the blessing of Him Who was the First and the Last in the Eternal Cosmos, as He was First and shall be Last within the Soul of Man. May Man be aware of his Inception and of his Destiny, and may the Grace of our Lord his God be with him. Amen. Amen.
